commands.name: clone
commands.description: Clone blocks from one region to another

examples: /execute if block ~ ~-1 ~ minecraft:diamond_block run say On diamond!
/execute if entity @e[type=zombie] run say Zombie nearby
/execute if score @s kills matches 10.. run say 10+ kills
/execute store result score @s diamonds run clear @s minecraft:diamond 0
/execute store success score @s flag run say Hi
/execute store result block ~ ~1 ~ foo int 1 run time query daytime
/execute store result entity @s Health float 1 run ...
/execute store result bossbar my:bar value run data get entity @s Health
